pageDescription: Recurring tasks that are created automatically as todos in every cycle. Responsible people come from lists such as the duties list.
emptyDescription: Create a package such as “Summer camp” or “Group leadership” and assign it to a cycle.
todoCounts: {open, plural, one {# open} other {# open}} of {total, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}
noCycles: Not assigned to any cycle yet – no tasks are created.
noItems: No tasks in this package yet.
deleteItemConfirm: Remove “{task}” from the package? Todos that were already created remain as regular todos.
activeHelp: Only active packages create and update tasks.
noCycleConfigs: There are no cycles yet. Create one under “Cycles” first.
assignHelp: After that the package repeats automatically in every cycle.
removalQuestion: What should happen to the tasks that were already created?

removalMode.future: Only delete tasks from the next cycle on

removalModeHelp.all: Completed tasks and tasks from past cycles are deleted as well.
removalModeHelp.future: Tasks of the current and past cycles remain as regular todos.
removalModeHelp.none: All tasks remain as regular todos.

previewHelp: Responsible people as they are listed today. “Exists” means the task has already been created.
previewEmpty: No tasks are created in this cycle.
syncedToast: {created, plural, =0 {No new tasks} one {# new task} other {# new tasks}}, {updated, plural, =0 {none updated} other {# updated}}
removedToast: {deleted, plural, =0 {No tasks deleted} one {# task deleted} other {# tasks deleted}}, {kept, plural, =0 {none kept} other {# kept}}
responsibleHelp: Pick rows from a list (e.g. a duty). The people listed there are taken over per cycle – all together in one task. If the list changes, open tasks of the current cycle change too; past cycles stay as they were.
noResponsibleLists: No suitable list available (one text and one people column).
dayOfMonthHelp: If the day does not exist (e.g. the 31st), the last day of the month is used.
eventTagHelp: A task is created for every event with this tag in the cycle – including events added later.
fixedOnlyOnceHint: A fixed date is only available for “Once per cycle”.
propagationHelp: Changes apply to open tasks in the current cycle and all future ones. Completed tasks and manually changed fields stay unchanged.

dueSummary.after: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after {anchor}
dueSummary.before: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before {anchor}
